remarks: JUST UPDATED! MUST SEE! Sun-filled 2-bedroom, 2-bath home located in the sought-after Ledgebrook community. Spanning 1,662 sq. ft., this beautifully updated home includes a large comfortable living area, a rare opportunity to have a garage space in the unit. Upon entering, you're greeted by a spacious foyer that leads into an open concept living and dining area with brand new wall to wall carpet and new paint in each room. Large sliding doors open to a generous deck where you can relax or entertain. The kitchen is equipped with all brand new appliances; dishwasher, microwave, refrigerator, stove/oven. The primary suite has a full bath, walk-in closet, and an additional closets for ample storage. The second bedroom features an additional loft area that can be used as an office or den, perfect for flexible living needs. Enjoy top-notch amenities including an in-ground pool, clubhouse, fitness center, sauna, and hot tub. The well-managed community also provides ample visitor parking and two deeded parking spaces in a covered garage, along with two additional permitted parking spots. Centrally located in Norwalk, this home is conveniently close to I-95, Route 1, the Merritt Parkway, Metro-North, and local bus lines, making it an ideal spot for commuters. Minutes from local amenities, shopping, and restaurants. NOT TO BE MISSED!
